definitions.explanation: Describes behavior, manner, or presence that makes others feel threatened or pressured into submission through implied power or aggression.

examples.japanese: {威圧的|いあつてき}な⟦{視線|しせん}→視線：14138_shisen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{威圧的|いあつてき}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{圧倒|あっとう}された→圧倒される：15413_attousareru⟧。
examples.english: I was overwhelmed by his intimidating presence.

examples.japanese: {威圧的|いあつてき}な⟦{言動|げんどう}→言動：14147_gendou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦パワハラ→パワハラ：05904_pawahara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{該当|がいとう}する→該当する：29179_gaitousuru⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Intimidating words and actions may constitute power harassment.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{威圧|いあつ}→威圧：09165_iatsu⟧ (coercion, intimidation) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (like). Describes creating a sense of fear or submission in others through one's demeanor, words, or physical presence. Always negative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {威圧的|いあつてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: intimidating attitude
- {威圧的|いあつてき}な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧: intimidating atmosphere
- {威圧的|いあつてき}な⟦{言動|げんどう}→言動：14147_gendou⟧: intimidating words and behavior
- {威圧的|いあつてき}な⟦{視線|しせん}→視線：14138_shisen⟧: intimidating look/gaze

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高圧的|こうあつてき}→高圧的：18279_kouatsuteki⟧な: overbearing, high-handed (uses authority/position to pressure)
- {脅迫的|きょうはくてき}な: threatening (implies explicit threats)
- ⟦{横柄|おうへい}→横柄：07317_ouhei⟧な: arrogant (rude, haughty demeanor)
- {強面|こわもて}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: tough-looking, fierce-faced (about physical appearance)
